what: crates/blaze-link/src/target.rs Line::find (around line 1035): every -l library is searched by one is_file() stat per (search dir x candidate file name), uncached, on every link: a link with 30 libraries over 15 dirs and 2 names each is ~900 stats, most answering not-there. A filter does not fit (the answer must come from the directory); the fast form is one read_dir per search dir per link, its names in a set, then a probe per (dir, name), so the misses cost no syscall. Keep the first-dir-first-name order. Lane filters (Andrew: hot membership tests where a definite no skips real work) found it; not changed by filters.

history.note: Reassigned from link (no live window) to no-fallback-link-native, which works in the same paths (Andrew 05:08: an item whose owner has no live window goes to a live lane within the hour).

target.rs: Line::may_have reads each search dir once per link (listing: ASCII-lowercased names, None when it or an entry cannot be read, which leaves names to a stat); find and default_library skip (dir, file) pairs the listing rules out, then stat as before, so first-dir-first-name order and case-insensitive file systems are unchanged. Non-ASCII names and names not starting with a plain component always stat. Tests: target/tests.rs a_search_directory_is_listed_with_its_names_case_folded, libq case in a_library_is_the_first_file_the_kind_allows_in_the_first_directory_that_has_one. ra clean, hot_lint 0, not compiled.
